verification.trust_boundary: Caller establishes header-chain membership and height. A header alone does not prove either, nor factual truth or exact issue time.

limits: The original certificate bytes are preserved; this is a present-day existence bound, not historical issue-time proof.
A verified result checks Bitcoin proof operations, header hash and proof of work independently. Explorer agreement supplies height and chain membership; no local consensus validation.
scope: The separate original pass verified 261 proofs; this final previously omitted certificate proof completes that frozen census. Not a new certificate enumeration.
